1887-5254-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-5254-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

141-1070-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-4050.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

225-851-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2921-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
2921-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

479-7658.easyPrerequisites: You have 13 or fewer cards in hand.
479-7658.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Drown in Dreams by paying {15}{U} minus {1} for each card in your hand, causing you to draw cards until you have thirteen cards in hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.
479-7658.notes: The cost can be reduced by {X}, where X equals the number of cards in your hand as you cast Stroke of Genius.

3259-5768-7175.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5768-7175.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4316-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

527-1409-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

4446-5170-6132-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-6132-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

5259-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5259-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Rude Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2366-3512-4068-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-4068-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2366-3512-4068-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-1659-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1659-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

148-1495-6822.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

1456-4050-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

65-4050-5037-5220-6280.description:
Activate Blazing Rootwalla's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it, discarding it into exile due to its madness ability.
Blazing Rootwalla's madness ability triggers, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla, adding {U}.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 1, causing you to draw Blazing Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2061-4125-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2061-4125-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1545-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1545-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1369-2645-5112-5116.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
1369-2645-5112-5116.description:
Activate Mairsil using Gilded Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
If desired, you may use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities using Mairsil, and then use Quicksilver Elemental's ability to use them infinitely.

152-1379-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {8}.
152-1379-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

2232-2459-3604-4050.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2232-2459-3604-4050.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or the command zone by paying {0} and commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cadric and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Rograkh with haste.
The Rograkh token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning the nontoken Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Rograkh token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3784-5090.notablePrerequisites:
Singing Bell Strike attached to Vhal.
Vhal has a toughness of at least seven.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3784-5090.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least seven {C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Vhal by paying {6}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1571-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Blightsteel Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill your creatures.
1571-4711.description:
Declare Blightsteel Colossus as an attacker.
Blightsteel Colossus' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Blightsteel Colossus, giving each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

579-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {6}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat.
